Ability.Name: -- MRC Smart Raid Heal --
Ability.Lua: if not MRC then MRC={} end local units={} if GetNumRaidMembers and GetNumRaidMembers()>0 then for i=1,GetNumRaidMembers() do units[#units+1]="raid"..i end elseif GetNumPartyMembers and GetNumPartyMembers()>0 then units[#units+1]="player" for i=1,GetNumPartyMembers() do units[#units+1]="party"..i end else units[1]="player" end return units local best,bestHP=nil,101 for _,u in ipairs(units) do if UnitExists(u) and not UnitIsDeadOrGhost(u) and UnitCanAssist("player",u) and UnitIsConnected(u) then local hp=100*UnitHealth(u)/math.max(1,UnitHealthMax(u)) local inRange=UnitInRange(u) if hp<bestHP and (inRange==nil or inRange==1) then best,bestHP=u,hp end end end if not best then return false end local spells={{name="Círculo de sanación",hp=70},{name="Rezo de sanación",hp=72},{name="Sanación relámpago",hp=60},{name="Sanación superior",hp=82},{name="Renovar",hp=88}} for _,sp in ipairs(spells) do if bestHP<sp.hp and IsUsableSpell(sp.name) then local start,duration=GetSpellCooldown(sp.name) if not start or not duration or duration<=1.6 or start+duration<=GetTime() then CastSpellByName(sp.name,best) return true end end end return false

Ability.Name: -- MRC Control --
Ability.Lua: if IsLeftControlKeyDown() and not MRC.ctrl then MRC.ctrl=true; StopRota=not StopRota; PQR_WriteToChat(StopRota and "MRC pausado" or "MRC activo") elseif not IsLeftControlKeyDown() then MRC.ctrl=false end; return false
